issues.explanation: Chapter 15 says all three brothers temporarily serve under Lü Bu, but the source has Liu Bei and his brothers withdraw to Xiaopei under Lü Bu's protection; Zhang Fei explicitly refuses to accompany Lü Bu into the city. Chapter 16 then correctly places Liu Bei at Xiaopei, creating a location/status mismatch at the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with wording such as: “刘备三兄弟退居小沛，暂受吕布庇护。”
